name: Suing Another Person
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to forgo personal vengeance and legal disputes against one another, instead embracing love and humility. Leviticus instructs us not to bear grudges but to love our neighbor as ourselves, while Deuteronomy reminds us that vengeance belongs to the Lord alone. Jesus encourages reconciliation through private dialogue rather than public litigation, emphasizing the importance of restoring relationships. Additionally, Christians are warned against judging others hypocritically and urged to esteem others above themselves, recognizing that serving God cannot be reconciled with pursuing worldly gain.
